run_vietnamese_translation: run the Vietnamese translation script to translate all English MDX files to Vietnamese
translate_mdx_to_vietnamese: translate all MDX files from the English units directory to Vietnamese using the auto_translate function
configure_translation_prompt: configure the translation prompt lambda with Vietnamese-specific rules for terminology and formatting
set_output_language: set the output language to Vietnamese for the auto_translate translation pipeline
translate_course_content: translate Hugging Face course content from English to Vietnamese preserving code blocks and formatting
